summary: "Ibong Adarna" by Anonymous is an early 19th century Filipino epic poem about a magical bird with healing powers. When King Fernando falls gravely ill, his three sons embark on a perilous quest to capture the legendary Adarna bird, whose enchanted songs can cure him. The prince who succeeds will inherit the throne.
